name: 2-to-4 Line Decoder
objectives: Construct 2-to-4 Decoder using 2 NOT (7404) and 4 AND (7408) gates.
theory: A 2-to-4 Decoder converts a 2-bit binary address (A1 A0) into 4 unique active output lines (Y0, Y1, Y2, Y3).

boolean_equations.Y0: Y0 = NOT A1 AND NOT A0

foundation.title: Foundation (Basic Gates)
foundation.description: Construct 2-to-4 Decoder using 2 NOT (7404) and 4 AND (7408) gates.

optimization.description: Rebuild 2-to-4 Decoder using ONLY NAND gates (IC 7400).

industrial.title: Universal NOR Gate Synthesis
industrial.description: Rebuild 2-to-4 Decoder using ONLY NOR gates (IC 7402).
